scope: 25-table projection, not full SQL Server installation

projection_rules.computed_columns: source-export snapshots retained; expressions recorded; not dynamically recomputed
projection_rules.decimal_money: canonical exact decimal strings in CSV and SQLite TEXT; exact arithmetic uses Python Decimal; CAST to REAL is approximate
projection_rules.datetime: validated ISO text; SQLite date functions supported
projection_rules.hierarchyid: opaque source text; no SQL Server methods
projection_rules.xml: opaque UTF-8 text; no XML query support
projection_rules.varbinary: opaque source hex text, preserved original bytes; no document rendering
projection_rules.spatial: opaque source text; no spatial methods
projection_rules.constraints: source PK/FK checked separately; SQL Server check/default/trigger/index behavior not recreated
